tldr: INCOMPLETE vs mandate (target 40+ searches): only 29 WebSearch calls ran; the shared 200-per-session cap was hit and the 30th was refused. WebFetch was EGRESS_BLOCKED for every domain tried (~66). Compensation: 36 npm/PyPI SDK packages were downloaded and read directly for API contracts (Zarinpal, Zibal, IDPay, NextPay, Pay.ir, Mellat, Parsian, Sadad/Sepehr, Jibit, Finnotech, Kavenegar, SMS.ir, Ghasedak, Melipayamak, Bale, Rubika, TronGrid, TONAPI, Etherscan V2, Moadian). Everything unsourced is null/UNVERIFIED with verify_how; a 13-item follow-up search plan is in the doc.

Gateway fee (Zarinpal-type payment-yar, single secondary source, confidence low): min(0.5% x A, 16,000 Toman) + 500 Toman = 1,000 / 5,500 / 16,500 / 16,500 Toman for 100k / 1M / 10M / 30M Toman orders (1.000% / 0.550% / 0.165% / 0.055%). Runtime truth: POST /pg/v4/payment/feeCalculation.json. Regulated Shaparak floor since 2023-06-25 (medium): 1,200 Rial fixed below 6,000,000 Rial else 0.02% capped at 40,000 Rial = 120 / 200 / 2,000 / 4,000 Toman. NextPay 1%/max 800 Toman is legacy and must not be used.

1405 caps: card-to-card 15,000,000 Toman per sending card per day (high, 5 press sources, raised from 10M); internet purchases 400,000,000 Toman per person per day (medium) and 200,000,000 per card (low); Zarinpal max single payment 100,000,000 Toman (error -41 text). A 30M Toman order cannot be one card-to-card transfer and must use gateway, Paya/Satna or USDT.

Eligibility is the main gateway risk: Shaparak told payment-yars to cut merchants selling crypto/VPN/betting; CBI directive pushes crypto exchanges to PSPs not payment-yars; gift-card / virtual-card / USDT-backed top-up classification is not named anywhere seen -> UNVERIFIED, all gateways risk_label=high. Lawful path: describe the product accurately, get the PSP's written category answer, keep fallbacks (second gateway, c2c to a business account, Paya/Satna, USDT). A Dey 1404/1405 closure claim was NOT confirmed.

Verification rules from SDK evidence: never trust callbacks; verify server-side with the amount from our DB; unverified payments are returned (Pay.ir after 30 min; Zarinpal reversal window 30 min; IDPay verify window error 54; Mellat verify->inquiry->settle else reverse); IP whitelists exist (Zarinpal -10, IDPay 13, Zibal 115, NextPay 1029, Mellat 421); card binding via Zarinpal cardPan / Zibal allowedCards+checkMobileWithCard is the lawful defence against triangular fraud. Full endpoint/param/error-code maps are in data/gateways.json; adapter contract and rules are in the doc.

Card-to-card: receiver fee 0 (low); tax visibility reported at >100 deposits AND >35M Toman per month (medium); freeze/triangular-fraud/fake-receipt risks; unique-amount tail 1..999 Toman pattern with collision handling; layered verification (unique amount, own bank SMS/statement, payer-name match, operator above threshold). Guardrail: no splitting to dodge caps, no third-party/rented accounts; lawful structure = registered business account + PSP primary + Moadian invoices.

Bale: https://tapi.bale.ai/bot{token}/{method}; sendInvoice / createInvoiceLink / answerPreCheckoutQuery / inquireTransaction; amount in Rial; transaction status pending|paid|failed|rejected; provider_token = card number OR (port+acceptor numbers) OR Bale wallet number; setWebhook takes only url (no secret token) so use secret path + inquireTransaction; wallet fees/limits/KYC levels and mini-app initData algorithm UNVERIFIED (Telegram-style HMAC placeholder to test). Rubika has an inline Payment button (SDK level); Eitaa none seen. Bale Safir OTP API found as an extra OTP channel.

Identity/SMS: Jibit https://napi.jibit.ir/ide (mobile<->national-code, card-owner name, IBAN matching endpoints) and Finnotech OAuth2 (cardToIban, ibanInquiry, mobileCardVerification) captured; Kavenegar/SMS.ir/Ghasedak/FarazSMS/Melipayamak OTP-template endpoints captured. ALL per-call and per-SMS prices are null/UNVERIFIED; Jibit birthDate format conflict; Shahkar backing and legal basis/consent unverified (hand to 04-legal).

USDT: TRC20 contract TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t and BEP20 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955 corroborated by exchange API samples in ccxt; TronGrid /v1/accounts/{addr}/transactions/trc20 with Tron-Pro-Api-Key (unauthenticated 3 QPS per third-party doc, low); Etherscan V1 deprecated 2025-08-15, V2 https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api chainid=56 (free-plan coverage of BSC unverified; RPC eth_getLogs fallback); TONAPI REST. Per-order HD address recommended; OFAC/Tether-freeze screening before crediting. At 257,000 Toman/USDT a 1 USDT sweep/chain cost is 25.7% of a 1M Toman order -> minimum viable USDT order about 10 USDT.

Moadian: technical flow captured (tp.tax.gov.ir/req/api/{self-tsp|tsp}/sync|async, sandboxrc.tax.gov.ir, JWS+JWE, fiscal ID + economic code + private key, INQUIRY_BY_UID statuses, header/body field names) and an SDK README says the API must be reached from an Iranian IP (hosting implication). Who must use it, thresholds, B2C rules, penalties and VAT rate are UNVERIFIED.

Deliverables validated: data/gateways.json (94 records, 19 UNVERIFIED), data/collection_methods.json (81, 20), data/identity_vendors.json (66, 41); fee stack and re-runnable data builder in scripts/research/. Doc is ~9.4k words (tables inflate), status draft; analysis only, not legal/tax advice.

C7 Jibit birthDate format: Jalali yyyyMMdd (node-jibit) vs yyyy-MM-dd (Python wrapper) -> unresolved, sandbox test.
C8 Paya cycle schedules differ across summaries and the year of 'Thursday 19 Tir' is not visible (1404 vs 1399) -> 4-cycle table used as latest, low confidence.
C9 Brief asked for Dey 1404/1405 gateway closures -> not confirmed by anything read; recurring Shaparak/CBI cuts of exchange gateways are documented but undated; not asserted.
